about.title: About RoboNest.3D
about.description: RoboNest.3D is the 3D printing workshop of RoboNest. We design, print and finish our products ourselves.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: RoboNest started as a robotics and engineering project. RoboNest.3D is its dedicated 3D printing workshop. We are not a reseller: we design and print functional parts, robotics components, tools, educational models and decorative pieces in our own workshop.

sections.title: How we work
sections.body: Almost everything we sell is made to order. After you order, we contact you by phone to confirm it, then print your items, inspect them and hand them to our delivery partner. You pay in cash when the order arrives. Orders above {threshold} need a 30% deposit first.

sections.title: Custom printing
sections.body: Engineers, students, makers and businesses send us their own 3D files. We review every file for printability, suggest a suitable material and send a price before anything is printed.

sections.title: Digital models
sections.body: Some of our designs are also available as downloadable STL, 3MF or OBJ files, so you can print them on your own printer.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Email {email}, or call {phones}. Working hours: {hours}.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Answers about ordering, delivery, payment, custom prints and digital files.

items.a: Physical orders can be paid in cash when they arrive, or directly to us. Contact us on WhatsApp from your order page to arrange it. Orders above 50,000 IQD (products total after discounts) need a 30% deposit first, and digital files are paid before download. A payment counts only after our team verifies it. We never ask for card details on the website.
Delivery is a flat 5,000 IQD for every location we deliver to. You see it in your cart and at checkout before you place the order.

items.q: How long does an order take?
items.a: Made-to-order items need the production time shown on the product page, plus delivery. These are estimates, not guaranteed dates, and we tell you by phone if anything changes.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.a: Yes, before it goes into production. Contact us by phone, email or the contact page with your order number.
Upload your STL, 3MF or OBJ file on the custom printing page, choose material, colour and size, and we send you a quote. If you accept, we create the order and you pay on delivery.

items.q: How do I get my digital files?
items.a: Digital files require an account. After payment is confirmed, the files appear under Account, then Downloads.

items.q: Is the price on the website final?
items.a: Yes. Our system calculates the price from the options you choose plus the flat delivery fee. A deposit, when required, is part of that total, not an extra charge.
PLA, PLA+, PETG, ABS and TPU, depending on the product. Each product page lists its materials. We do not offer resin printing.

delivery.title: Delivery and shipping
delivery.description: A flat delivery fee for every location we deliver to, and how we arrange delivery with you.
delivery.intro: The fee is the same everywhere we deliver and is added automatically in your cart and at checkout. Our delivery partner brings the order to the address you give us.

sections.title: Order confirmation
sections.body: When you place an order you see a confirmation page with your order number. Keep its link to return to the order. If you have an account, the order also appears under My orders. We then call you on the number you gave us to confirm the order and arrange delivery.

sections.title: When will my order arrive?
sections.body: Made-to-order items are delivered after production and a quality check; each product page shows its usual production time. Production and delivery times are estimates, not guaranteed dates. We tell you about delays by phone.

sections.title: Order status
sections.body: The order page shows the status our team sets as your order moves forward (for example confirmed, printing, ready for delivery). We do not offer real-time courier tracking.

sections.title: If you are not available
sections.body: The courier will call you. If a delivery attempt fails, we contact you to arrange another attempt.

sections.title: Digital files
sections.body: Digital 3D models are not shipped and have no delivery fee. They are downloaded from your account after payment is confirmed.

delivery.flatFee: Delivery costs {fee} to every location we deliver to.

returns.title: Returns, refunds and cancellations
returns.description: How to report a problem with an order and how cancellations work.

sections.title: Check your order on delivery
sections.body: Please inspect your items when the courier arrives. If something is damaged, missing or not what you ordered, tell the courier and contact us as soon as possible with your order number and photos.

sections.title: Problems with an item
sections.body: If an item has a printing defect or does not match your order, contact us. We review each case with you and explain what we can do for your order.

sections.title: Made-to-order and customized items
sections.body: Most items are printed after you order, to the material, colour, size, engraving or file you chose. Please check your choices carefully before you order.

sections.title: Cancelling an order
sections.body: You can ask to cancel an order before it goes into production. Contact us with your order number. For orders with a deposit, see the payment and deposit policy.

sections.title: How refunds are paid
sections.body: Because orders are paid in cash or by manual transfer, any refund we agree is arranged with you directly.

sections.title: Return periods
sections.body: We have not published a fixed return period yet. Until we do, contact us about any problem and we will handle it with you case by case.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What personal information RoboNest.3D collects, why, who processes it, and your choices.

sections.title: Orders and delivery
sections.body: To fulfil an order we collect your name, mobile number, delivery address, any notes, and the order details (products, options, prices, discount, delivery fee and status history). We share your name, phone number and address with our delivery partner only to deliver your order.

sections.title: Accounts and phone verification
sections.body: If you create an account, we store your name, mobile number, language preference and a hashed password (we never store the password itself). To verify your number we send it to our SMS verification provider, Twilio, which sends and checks the code. We do not store or see the code.

sections.title: Payments and deposits
sections.body: We never receive card details: payments are made in cash or directly to us and verified by our team. For each payment we record the amount, how it was paid, any note our team made when checking it, and who verified it. Messages you send us on WhatsApp are handled by WhatsApp under its own terms.

sections.title: Files you upload
sections.body: Files you upload for custom printing or product options are stored privately. They are never published and are only available to our staff to prepare and produce your order. Files you buy as digital products are only available to your account.

sections.title: Contact form
sections.body: When you use the contact form we store your name, email, subject and message, and send them by email to our team through our email provider, Resend, so we can reply.

sections.title: Cookies and technical data
body: We use only essential cookies: your sign-in session, your cart, your language and theme choice, and a short-lived cookie while you verify your phone. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies.
For security and to limit abuse we record request counts and administrator actions, using a one-way hash of your IP address rather than the address itself.

sections.title: Who processes data for us
sections.body: The website, database and file storage run on Cloudflare. Email from the contact form is sent through Resend. SMS verification uses Twilio when it is enabled. New-order alerts to our owners are sent through Telegram and contain only the order number, amounts, deposit status, order type and a link to our admin area, never your name, phone or address.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Passwords are stored as salted hashes, sign-in sessions use protected cookies whose tokens we store only as hashes, uploaded files are private, and staff access is restricted by role and logged.

sections.title: How long we keep data
sections.body: We have not set fixed retention periods yet. We keep order records while they are needed to fulfil, support and account for orders.

sections.title: Your requests
sections.body: You can ask us to show, correct or delete your personal information by contacting us at {email}. We may need to keep some order records where they are required for accounting or legal reasons, and we will tell you if that applies.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.description: The terms that apply when you order from RoboNest.3D.

sections.title: Orders and acceptance
sections.body: Placing an order sends us a request. An order is confirmed after we contact you by phone and, for orders that need one, after your deposit is verified. We may decline an order that we cannot produce or deliver, and we tell you if we do.

sections.title: Prices
sections.body: Prices are in Iraqi dinars (IQD) and are calculated by our system from the options you choose. The total shown when you place the order, including options, any discount and the flat {fee} delivery fee, is the amount you pay.

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: Payment is made on delivery or directly to RoboNest.3D, arranged on WhatsApp, and counts only after our team verifies it. Orders above {threshold} need an insurance deposit first, as described in the payment and deposit policy. Digital files unlock only after the full payment is verified.

sections.title: Product descriptions
sections.body: We describe and photograph our products as accurately as we can. 3D-printed items can show small differences in colour, surface finish and layer lines from the photos.

sections.title: Custom prints and your files
body: You confirm that you have the right to print the files and designs you send us and that they do not infringe anyone else's rights. You remain responsible for the content, dimensions and fitness for purpose of your own designs.
We may refuse files or requests that infringe others' rights or describe prohibited items, such as weapons or weapon parts.

sections.title: Digital files
sections.body: Digital models are licensed for your personal use. You may print them for yourself, but you may not resell or redistribute the files.

sections.title: Using printed parts
sections.body: 3D-printed parts are made with care but are not certified for safety-critical use. Please use functional parts within reasonable limits.

sections.title: Accounts
sections.body: Keep your password private. An account requires a mobile number that you verify by SMS.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any question about these terms, email {email} or call {phones} ({hours}).

payment.title: Payment and deposit policy
payment.description: How you pay for orders, and when and how an insurance deposit is required.
payment.summary: Pay on delivery or directly to RoboNest.3D, arranged on WhatsApp. Orders above {threshold} need a deposit of 30% of the products total first. A payment counts only after our team verifies it.

sections.title: Paying for your order
sections.body: Physical items can be paid in cash to the courier when your order arrives. You can also pay RoboNest.3D directly: the order page has a button to contact us on WhatsApp (0751-891-1112) with your order number and the amount. This website never takes card or online payments.

sections.title: When a deposit is required
body: Orders whose products total, after discounts and without the {fee} delivery fee, is more than {threshold} need a deposit before we confirm them. An order of exactly {threshold} does not need a deposit.
The deposit is 30% of that products total, rounded down to whole dinars. For example, a products total of 60,000 IQD needs a deposit of 18,000 IQD. The delivery fee is not part of this calculation.
The deposit is part of your order total, not an extra charge: the rest is paid on delivery (or directly, by arrangement).

sections.title: How to pay the deposit
body: After you place the order, the order page shows the deposit amount and a button to contact us on WhatsApp to arrange the payment.

A payment or deposit counts as received only after a RoboNest.3D owner has checked that the money actually arrived and confirmed it. Opening WhatsApp, sending a message, a reference or a screenshot does not by itself mark anything as paid. Your order is confirmed and production starts only after the deposit is verified.

sections.title: If a payment cannot be confirmed
sections.body: If we cannot find your payment, the order page tells you and we will contact you, or you can message us on WhatsApp.

sections.title: Digital files
sections.body: Digital files are paid before download: contact us on WhatsApp from the order page. Downloads unlock only after our team has verified the full payment.

sections.title: Deposits on cancelled orders
sections.body: Our rules for returning a deposit when an order is cancelled have not been finalized yet. If you need to cancel an order after paying a deposit, contact us and we will explain the options for your order.

products.title: Products

fields.slugHint: Lower-case letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. robot-arm-kit
fields.descriptionHint: Plain text. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
fields.salePriceHint: Must be lower than the base price. Leave empty for no sale.
fields.costPriceHint: Internal. Used only for profit analytics.
fields.stockHint: Only used when availability is In stock.
fields.specsHint: One per line: Label EN | Label AR | Value EN | Value AR

products.created: Product created. You can now add images, options and files.

images.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 8 MB. Square images around 1200 px work best.

preview.intro: The storefront shows an interactive 3D preview only when a preview proxy is approved. A proxy is a separate, simplified copy: fewer triangles, fine detail removed, scaled to a unit size so real dimensions are not shown. Paid files are never published. Visitors can still download the proxy itself, so only approve shapes you are comfortable sharing at that level of detail.
preview.noneLive: No approved preview: the storefront shows photos only.
preview.generateHint: Builds a simplified proxy on the server from an STL, OBJ or GLB file up to 25 MB. The original is only read, never changed or published.
preview.generated: Preview generated. Review it below, then approve it.
preview.uploadHint: A simplified GLB made elsewhere (up to 3 MB, 20,000 triangles, no textures). It is checked by its content and refused if it is a paid file or not reduced.
preview.approveHint: Only Owners and Super Admins can approve. Approving replaces the current live preview.
preview.approved: Preview approved. It is now shown on the product page.
preview.cannotApprove: Only an Owner or Super Admin can approve previews.
preview.legacyGlb: This product has a legacy GLB from the old 3D viewer. It is never shown or served (it may be the full paid geometry) and was kept in storage, not deleted.
preview.legacyMissing: The legacy GLB is no longer in storage.
preview.legacyFails: The legacy GLB does not qualify as a preview ({reasons}). Generate a proxy instead.
preview.legacyPasses: The legacy GLB would pass the proxy checks ({triangles} triangles), but it is not published. To use it, upload it as a proxy and approve it after reviewing it.
preview.turntableLegacy: {count, plural, one {# turntable frame} other {# turntable frames}} from the previous preview system are stored but no longer shown.

files.hint: STL, 3MF, OBJ, GLB or ZIP, up to 95 MB. Stored privately; only paying customers can download.
files.notDigital: Digital files can be attached to Digital or Print + digital products.

options.priceDeltaHint: For text, file or single checkbox: added when filled/ticked.
options.pricePerUnitHint: Number fields: added per unit above the minimum.
options.minMaxHint: Number: value range. Text: length range.
options.none: No options. Customers buy the product as-is.

products.archiveHint: Hides the product from the store. Past orders keep their snapshot.
products.deleteHint: Permanent. Only possible for products that were never ordered.

errors.bad_state: That preview is not in a state that allows this.
errors.stored_object_changed: The stored preview no longer matches what was generated; generate a new one.
errors.price_too_high: The price would exceed the maximum.

customers.resetText: After verifying the customer by phone or WhatsApp, generate a one-time link (valid for 1 hour) and send it to them.

digitalFiles.title: Digital files
digitalFiles.text: Original paid files, kept private. Buyers download them only after their full payment is confirmed. 3D preview proxies are a separate, public, reduced asset (see the 3D previews tab).
digitalFiles.filesExplain: These are the original files customers pay for. They are never public; activating a file only lets entitled buyers download it.
digitalFiles.previewsExplain: Preview proxies are reduced, unit-sized meshes shown in the storefront viewer. They are not the paid files. Approve them after reviewing them in 3D on the product page.
digitalFiles.selected: {count, plural, one {# file selected} other {# files selected}}
digitalFiles.selectPage: Select all files on this page
digitalFiles.activateTitle: Activate {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
digitalFiles.deactivateTitle: Deactivate {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
digitalFiles.activateText: Entitled buyers with a confirmed payment will be able to download these files. They stay private.
digitalFiles.deactivateText: Nobody will be able to download these files until they are activated again. Use this when replacing a file.
digitalFiles.buyersWarning: {buyers, plural, one {# buyer} other {# buyers}} currently have access to these files and will lose it until you activate them again.
digitalFiles.acknowledge: I understand that existing buyers lose access.

errors.last_super_admin: There must be at least one active Owner or Super Admin.
errors.owner_protected: Owner accounts are protected. Only another owner can reset their password or 2FA, and owners cannot be demoted, disabled or deleted.

admins.ownerProtected: Owner account: cannot be demoted, disabled or deleted. Only another owner can reset its password or 2FA.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Every payment is arranged with the customer on WhatsApp and counts only after an Owner confirms it was received. Nothing a customer does marks a payment as paid.
payments.ruleDelivery: Delivery: flat {fee} for every supported location.
payments.ruleThreshold: A deposit is required when the order amount is strictly greater than {threshold} (exactly {threshold} does not need one).
payments.ruleBase: The amount compared is the products subtotal after discounts, without the delivery fee.
payments.instructionsHint: Account name and number or wallet number, plus anything the customer must include. Shown on the order page.

errors.instructions_required: Each enabled method needs instructions in English and Arabic.

payments.ruleRate: The deposit is {percent}% of that amount, rounded down to whole dinars (for example {base} → {example}).
payments.manualExplain: Optional. If you want customers to transfer to an account (FIB, QiCard, ZainCash), enable the method and add the details. They are shown with the WhatsApp payment step. They are information only and never mark anything paid.
payments.ruleManual: Customers pay RoboNest.3D directly and contact us on WhatsApp. An Owner checks the money actually arrived, then confirms it here.
payments.ruleDownloads: Digital files unlock only after the full payment is confirmed. A verified deposit never unlocks them.
payments.onlineRetired: Automatic online payments (the FIB adapter and its callback) are retired. Old payment records are kept for reference.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Telegram alerts to the owners for new orders and deposit submissions.
notifications.configured: Configured for {count, plural, one {# chat} other {# chats}}.
notifications.notConfiguredText: Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_IDS as server secrets. Orders are still saved; their alerts wait here and are sent once configuration exists.
notifications.testHint: Sends a fixed test message to every configured chat. No custom text can be sent from here.
notifications.delivered: {count, plural, =0 {not delivered} one {delivered to # chat} other {delivered to # chats}}

errors.rate_limited: Too many test messages. Wait a few minutes.
errors.test_failed: Delivery failed. See the error on the event below.
errors.test_skipped: This event is already sent or being sent.

notifications.fewerThanOwners: Fewer than two recipients are configured. Both owners should be in TELEGRAM_CHAT_IDS.

hint.notConfigured: Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_IDS, then retry.
hint.token: Telegram rejected the bot token. Create a new token with @BotFather (/token) and update the secret.
hint.notStarted: This person has not pressed Start on the bot, or blocked it. Ask them to open the bot and press Start, then retry.
hint.chatNotFound: Wrong chat id, or the person never started the bot. Re-check the id with scripts/telegram-chat-ids.mjs.
hint.rateLimited: Telegram is rate limiting. It will be retried automatically.
hint.network: Telegram could not be reached. It will be retried automatically.
hint.other: See the error text; retry after fixing the cause.

notifications.invalidChatIds: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} in TELEGRAM_CHAT_IDS {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} not a valid chat id and {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} ignored. Fix the value so no owner is missed.

paymentsQueue.ownerOnly: Only an Owner can confirm, dispute or refund payments. You can view the queue.
paymentsQueue.confirmTitle: Confirm that this payment was received
paymentsQueue.confirmWarning: Only confirm after you have checked the money itself: the transfer in the account, or the cash in hand. A customer's message, reference or screenshot is not proof.
paymentsQueue.receivedAmountHint: Type the amount you actually saw. It must be exactly {amount}.
paymentsQueue.evidenceHint: For example: FIB transfer ref 1234 seen in the account on 12 Oct.
paymentsQueue.checkedLabel: I checked that this money actually arrived.
paymentsQueue.disputeText: Use this when a customer says they paid but you cannot find the money. Nothing is deleted and no files are released.
paymentsQueue.publicNoteHint: Optional. Shown on the customer's order page.
paymentsQueue.refundText: Only record a refund you have ALREADY returned to the customer outside the website. This does not move any money. For a full payment it also locks the customer's downloads again.
paymentsQueue.refundReason: How and when the money was returned
paymentsQueue.codHint: Physical order: usually paid in cash on delivery. Confirm it here once the cash has reached you.
paymentsQueue.downloadsLocked: Downloads stay locked until the full payment is confirmed.

errors.not_refundable: There is no confirmed payment to refund here.
